source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Once per turn, in your opponent's turn, after another **AELDARI** unit of yours is **destroyed** and its last model removed, if this model is still on the battlefield, you can remove it and set it up again as near as it can be to where that last model fell, not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit. This does not stop it being eligible to move.

detail.trigger: just after another friendly AELDARI unit is destroyed in opponent turn
